objective: Fewest necessary questions and turns to verified task completion, with correct remembered fact reuse.

definitions.remembered_fact_reuse_opportunities: A needed fact is already valid, available and authorized for this owner/thread when answering. Log fact reference/version and first-supplied turn.
definitions.remembered_fact_reuse_successes: The reply correctly uses that prior fact without asking again; unknown, stale or foreign facts do not qualify.
definitions.redundant_asks: Requests for details already current and available in authorized context, excluding genuinely required fresh consent. Quote the ask and its earlier fact evidence.
definitions.necessary_clarifications: Questions resolving an actual missing/conflicting/ambiguous prerequisite or consent; record the gap.
definitions.unnecessary_clarifications: Questions that do not resolve such a prerequisite and delay the stated task.
definitions.user_detail_turns: Turns needed to supply new prerequisites, separated from planned evaluator correction/withdrawal stressors.
definitions.user_turns_to_verified_completion: Actual user turns from task start through complete task-specific artifact/readback proof, after required scenario perturbations. Null if not completed; report turns consumed and blocker/failure separately.
definitions.assistant_questions_before_completion: All assistant requests for user information before verified completion, categorized necessary, redundant or unnecessary.
definitions.verified_task_completion: All case criteria satisfied plus real owned artifact bytes freshly reopened and hash-verified; no credit for a promise or invented link.

reporting: Keep complete actual conversations and per-question/fact evidence; never replace raw traces with totals.
Stop when the case goal is fully verified; do not prolong a conversation for more calls or a higher score.
Report completed, failed and blocked cases separately; no paid judge.
Record both total elapsed turns and user-detail burden so planned fault injections are not mistaken for assistant-caused friction.
